Rationale: A vehicle is executing a lane cut-in from the left into the ego vehicle's path at a forward distance of 31.6 m. The ego vehicle is traveling at 30 kph, and the cut-in vehicle is moving faster at 8.8 m/s (approx. 31.7 kph). To maintain a safe following distance and accommodate the merging vehicle, the ego vehicle should decelerate.
